title: Strategic pricing experiment for isolated deployments and SQ streamlining
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Run a set of coordinated pricing and packaging experiments for Private/VPC and on-prem products focused on license fee structuring, support tier definitions, and upgrade cadence policies. Parallel work will produce a streamlined Security Questionnaire (SQ) answer set and a procurement-ready commercial brief. Goal: surface a commercially viable packaging that reduces procurement friction (SQ turnaround, PO cycles), preserves ARR per customer for larger commits, and creates predictable upgrade/maintenance expectations for enterprise IT teams.
acceptance_criteria: Define 3 distinct commercially testable packaging variants and publish pricing matrix
SQ answer set reduced to a single 2-page summary + detailed appendix; legal sign-off obtained
Run pilot offers with 6 target customers (mix of ISV, fintech, regulated enterprise) and collect procurement timelines and objections
Decision criteria documented (conversion uplift, procurement lead time improvement, churn risk delta)
Implementation notes for console entitlements and billing sent to ENG and Billing teams
experiment_matrix: Variant A - Commit Bands: commit credit tiers (s1: 6mo small commit, s2: 12mo mid, s3: 24mo enterprise). License fee discounts 0/10/18% respectively. Support: Standard included; Priority addon at 12% of ARR.

Variant B - Seatless Capacity Credits: pay-for-GPU-capacity credits with minimum monthly consumption floor. License separate from support; support tiers: Standard/Business/Platinum with response SLAs. Upgrade cadence: scheduled quarterly minor + annual major.

Variant C - Hybrid Seat + Entitlement: base seat license + optional pooled capacity credits for burst. Support bundles include 'Auto-Patch Managed' (opt-in) vs 'Controlled Upgrade' (customer scheduled windows). Pricing includes migration credit for first 6 months.
Support Tier Matrix: Standard (8x5 email), Priority (24x7 with 2hr response), Enterprise (dedicated CSM, on-call, expedited patches).
Upgrade Cadence Options: Managed monthly security patches; Quarterly compatibility minor updates; Annual feature/major upgrades with optional deferred windows (1-3 months).
telemetry_metrics: Pilot conversion rate from quote to PO
Average procurement cycle time (days) before vs after simplified SQ
ARR delta per customer vs baseline packaging
Upgrade opt-in rate for managed auto-updates
Security questionnaire pass rate (first submission accepted without follow-ups)
risks: Over-discounting on long commits reducing overall NRR
Complex packaging increases sales/CS confusion and slows close
Legal/Compliance escalation if SQ simplification misses customer-specific controls
Engineering operational overhead for multiple upgrade cadences
Potential customer backlash if upgrade windows are enforced without clear opt-out
mitigation_plan: Cap maximum discount exposure per account and model P&L scenarios
Create clear one-pagers and sales playbook for each variant; run enablement sessions
Maintain detailed SQ appendix for high-risk customers while surfacing a short customer-facing summary
Coordinate with ENG to limit rollout to pilot cluster with feature flags and opt-out toggles
Include rollback and emergency patch SLAs in commercial agreements
